🚨 Another DOGE ETF filing just dropped.

21Shares becomes the third firm (after Grayscale & Bitwise) to chase a spot Dogecoin ETF in the US.

Filed the same day they launched a DOGE ETP in Switzerland. Coordinated? Strategic?

The meme coin keeps getting institutionalized.
